_howToEdit: Prices are in euros and include VAT (vatRate is used only if Stripe Tax isn't set up). Change a price here; nothing else needs editing. cohortDays: how long one cohort's access lasts. extendDays: how long an extension lasts, counted from the member's first join. year: the price for a cohort plus a full year, offered at payment (extending later costs the extension price). studyGroup: the yearly Study Group subscription. stripePriceId is the Stripe Price for it (test mode first, then the live one); reminderDaysBefore: when the renewal reminder email goes out (to confirm with an adviser); termsVersion: change it whenever the Study Group terms change, so each member's acceptance records which version they agreed to.
